title: Update attrs to 22.1.0 and fix test.
description:
The ValueError from InValidator has been augmented to include a lot of other structured information that, for simplicity, we can ignore in the test.

**Motivation**

In the [nixpkgs](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs) package manager, `attrs` has been updated, and it becomes necessary to update all of its consumers.
